name: hydra-styling
description: Hydra Security's React and Tailwind CSS design system.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @hydra-security/showcase && npm run build:starter
scripts.check: npm run test:firebase-compat && npm run build && npm run test:integration && npm run test:package
scripts.audit: npm run audit:app && npm run audit:firebase
scripts.audit:signatures: npm audit signatures && npm audit signatures --prefix tools/firebase
scripts.setup:firebase: npm ci --prefix tools/firebase --ignore-scripts && node tools/firebase/patch-cli.mjs && npm run test:firebase-compat
scripts.test:integration: node tools/firebase/node_modules/firebase-tools/lib/bin/firebase.js emulators:exec --project demo-hydra-ui --only auth,firestore,storage "node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/firebase-rules.test.mjs && npm run test:browser"
